skills.name: analyze-company-data
skills.description: Use Basedash to answer questions about company metrics, trends, lookups, and analysis over connected data sources.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Basedash 连接的数据源回答公司指标、趋势、查找和分析问题。

skills.name: discover-company-data
skills.description: Discover the data sources available through Basedash. Use when the user asks what company data, databases, warehouses, or SaaS sources are available.
skills.description_zh: 发现 Basedash 中可用的公司数据、数据库、数据仓库或 SaaS 数据源。

skills.name: inspect-dashboards-and-charts
skills.description: List and inspect dashboards and charts available through Basedash. Use when the user wants to find, review, or understand existing dashboards or charts.
skills.name_hint: inspect · 看板 · and · 图表
skills.description_zh: 列举并检查 Basedash 现有仪表板和图表，帮助查找、评审或理解其内容。

skills.name: manage-dashboards-and-charts
skills.description: Create and edit Basedash dashboards and charts with natural-language instructions. Use when the user wants to build, save, or change a dashboard or chart.
skills.name_hint: manage · 看板 · and · 图表
skills.description_zh: 依据自然语言要求创建、保存或修改 Basedash 仪表板与图表。
